rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation rejects the E07 count comparison. The raw current-period schedule closes at fair value $1,780.072m (table 19 row 19), while extracted holdings total $1,779.362m, only $0.710m or 0.04% lower. A distinct later portfolio schedule begins at table 23 and contains comparative positions, demonstrating that raw schedule rows are multi-period and cannot support the oracle's unscoped source count of 933 against 369 current output positions. The filing-value anchor therefore supports the output and identifies the E07 source-count anchor as bad, not a holdings data error.
